question: Should OpenClaw core accept experiment-gated Claw lifecycle diagnostics in Doctor now, or should this ownership/diagnostic capability remain outside the core until the Claws product direction is approved?
rationale: The patch introduces a new core diagnostic surface and a cross-owner lifecycle model, while the stack remains under active maintainer review; implementation correctness cannot determine the permanent core boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental core check
options.body: Accept the Doctor ownership boundary, then require refreshed final-head real-behavior proof before merging this stacked slice.

options.title: Pause the stack for product direction
options.body: Keep the branch open but defer merge until a maintainer confirms the Claws lifecycle model and its proper core versus extension boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental core check
recommendation.body: Accept the Doctor ownership boundary, then require refreshed final-head real-behavior proof before merging this stacked slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment defines the central runtime and read-only correctness boundary for this diagnostic feature.
